display.purpose: New chat prompts and the largest stage headings.

headline.purpose: Dialog titles and major panel headings.

label.purpose: Field labels, hints, menus, and supporting controls.

shadows.name: sticky-separation
shadows.purpose: Only after content scrolls beneath a fixed bar.

shadows.name: composer-float
shadows.purpose: The composer work surface only, never ordinary cards.

motion.name: ease-arrive
motion.purpose: Travel and settling into an intended position.

motion.name: ease-leave
motion.purpose: Fast removal after content has been read.

motion.name: ease-overshoot
motion.purpose: Small switches and marks that need a tactile landing.

motion.name: spring-panel
motion.purpose: Panel unfolding with one restrained settle.

motion.name: spring-composer
motion.purpose: Composer movement between new chat and live thread.

motion.name: spring-chevron
motion.purpose: Small directional marks such as select chevrons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive house action, achromatic so it cannot be mistaken for a persona.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { cursor: pointer; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-button); padding: 6px 14px; background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-on-primary); font: 500 16px/1.6 var(--font-sans); transition: background 150ms var(--ease-fade); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-fg); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action carried by a translucent tonal wash.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { cursor: pointer; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-button); padding: 6px 14px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 8%, transparent); color: var(--color-muted); font: 500 16px/1.6 var(--font-sans); transition: background 150ms var(--ease-fade), color 150ms var(--ease-fade); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 13%, transparent); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-fg); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A quiet action that appears through hover tone rather than a permanent shape.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { cursor: pointer; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-button); padding: 6px 14px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted); font: 500 16px/1.6 var(--font-sans); transition: background 150ms var(--ease-fade), color 150ms var(--ease-fade); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-surface-2); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-fg); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: var(--color-user-bg); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A destructive action that warns through color without becoming a solid alarm block.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { cursor: pointer; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-button); padding: 6px 14px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-danger) 12%, transparent); color: var(--color-danger); font: 500 16px/1.6 var(--font-sans); transition: background 150ms var(--ease-fade); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-danger) 20%, transparent); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-fg); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A field that expresses focus by lifting its existing border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--color-text); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-field-label { color: var(--color-dim); font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; } .ds-field-input { border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 7px 10px; background: var(--color-surface-2); color: var(--color-text); font: 400 14px/20px var(--font-sans); outline: none; } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-dim); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-dim); outline: none; } .ds-field-input:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: 0.45; }

components.name: Active Navigation Row
components.description: A selected room expressed through one tonal row and a quiet rounded icon.
components.css: .ds-nav-row { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 36px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; cursor: pointer; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-xl); padding: 0 12px; background: var(--color-user-bg); color: var(--color-text); font: 400 14px/1 var(--font-sans); text-align: left; } .ds-nav-row svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: var(--color-surface-2); } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-fg); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-row:active { background: var(--color-user-bg); }

components.name: Picked Pill
components.description: A compact toggle whose solid fill carries selection without a border grid.
components.css: .ds-pill { cursor: pointer; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--color-picked); color: var(--color-text); font: 500 16px/1.25 var(--font-sans); } .ds-pill:hover { color: var(--color-text); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-fg); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pill[aria-pressed="false"] { background: var(--color-user-bg); color: var(--color-muted); }

components.name: Dialog Card
components.description: A titled form card separated by tone, one hairline, and no decorative shadow.
components.html:
New persona

Choose how this member of the household works.
components.css: .ds-dialog { max-width: 460px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); padding: 20px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-dialog:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-dim); }

components.name: Composer
components.description: The primary work surface, visually stable while text and attachments change inside it.
components.html: Ready
components.css: .ds-composer { border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-composer); padding: 12px; background: var(--color-composer); color: var(--color-text); box-shadow: var(--elevation-composer); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-composer textarea { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; resize: none; border: 0; padding: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text); font: 400 16px/1.6 var(--font-sans); outline: none; } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color: var(--color-dim); } .ds-composer footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; color: var(--color-dim); font-size: 12px; } .ds-composer footer span { flex: 1; } .ds-composer button { cursor: pointer; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-button-sm); padding: 4px 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-composer button:hover { background: var(--color-surface-2); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-composer button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-fg); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-composer .ds-send { background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-on-primary); }

components.name: Ask Option
components.description: One answer row in the active question card, using tone and persona ownership rather than a form outline.
components.css: .ds-ask-option { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 12px; cursor: pointer; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--color-surface-2); color: var(--color-muted); font-family: var(--font-sans); text-align: left; } .ds-ask-option:hover { background: var(--color-user-bg); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-ask-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-fg); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ask-number { display: grid; width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; place-items: center; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-dim); font-size: 12px; } .ds-ask-option strong { display: block; color: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; } .ds-ask-option small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--color-dim); font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; }

narrative.overview:
Manor feels like a calm, precise, inhabited workspace rather than a generic developer tool. Its rooms are achromatic and quiet. The people inside them provide the color, motion, and character. Rounded typography and continuous corners soften a dense desktop tool without making it toy like.

Soft precision governs the details. Controls are compact but readable, state changes are direct, and motion explains arrival, departure, progress, or spatial relationship. Decorative effects do not compete with the work.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic house chrome with persona owned color.
Tonal depth before borders, and borders before shadow.
Rounded type, continuous corners, and compact readable controls.
Purposeful motion with a complete reduced motion path.
Desktop density that stays personal rather than technical.

rules.name: The One Chromatic Voice Rule
rules.body: House chrome stays achromatic. Persona colors carry identity, while violet and status colors appear only when their semantics are active.

rules.name: The Theme Polarity Rule
rules.body: Light is not an inversion of dark. Token roles stay fixed while the luminance stack reverses around a white upper surface.

rules.name: The Nudge, Never Shout Rule
rules.body: Emphasis stops at weight 600. Manor does not use bold as a substitute for hierarchy.

rules.name: The House Sans Rule
rules.body: Geist is the house sans on the Mac, the web and the phone. SF Pro Rounded and the system face only stand in until it has loaded.

rules.name: The Least Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use tone first, a hairline second, and shadow only for unavoidable overlap. Resting cards, rows, and panels stay shadowless.

rules.name: The One House Radius Rule
rules.body: Use the shared radius tokens. A one off radius is justified only by a measured silhouette that the scale cannot express.

dos: Do use the existing semantic tokens so dark and light themes move together.
Do let persona color identify ownership while keeping shared chrome achromatic.
Do use tonal layering before adding borders or shadow.
Do keep controls compact without dropping below the 12px metadata floor.
Do use motion to explain state, sequence, or spatial change and preserve reduced motion behavior.
Do keep the central conversation readable and protect it from side panel overlap.
donts: Don't introduce a fixed chromatic brand accent beside persona colors.
Don't add shadow to resting cards, rows, or panels when tone can separate them.
Don't use font weights above 600 or oversized type to manufacture hierarchy.
Don't use emoji, ad hoc inline SVG, or a different icon family in product UI.
Don't turn every section into an outlined card or every state into a bordered pill.
Don't treat the future mobile experience as a scaled down desktop shell.
